browser_use.description: how to drive a web browser: open an address, read the page snapshot, then click, type or choose by the element reference

web_research.description: how to search the open web, read a web page or the owner record of a domain, and name the web sources in the answer

spreadsheets.description: how to read a spreadsheet file with the table tools: its sheets, columns, rows and single cells

emails.description: how to read e-mail documents: sender, recipients, date, subject, headers, copies and threads

folders_and_files.description: how to see what a collection holds: datasets, folders, file types, counts and dates, and how to find a file by its name or path

passages.description: how to find the exact passages or pages that answer a question with search_passages, inside many documents or one

entities.description: how to list the people, organisations, places, e-mail addresses and amounts that documents name

plan_editing.description: how to change a research plan tree: add, rename, move or remove a section or a task, and approve or continue the plan

deep_research.description: how to start in-depth research with a plan and helpers, and when a question needs it

after_a_result.description: what to do after each call returns: use its result, change the arguments or take the next step, and never send the same call again

todo_upkeep.description: how to change a todo list that exists: plain item ids, one status for each item, and each item done or cancelled before the answer

document_ids.description: how to name a document in a call: the 64-character file_hash from a search result, never a file name or a path

call_arguments.description: how to fill in the arguments of a tool call: only the names its schema gives, a list where it asks for a list, and no extra quotes

collection_names.description: how to name a collection or a dataset in a call: the exact name that list_collections returns

no_results.description: what to do when a search finds nothing: remove filters, split a phrase, try other forms of a name, then say what is missing

reviewing_a_report.description: how to review, grade or check a report given in the brief: search for the facts of each claim, never for the report title
